title: Information Retrieval Induced Safety Degradation in AI Agents
benchmark_measurement: The benchmarks (BBQ and AirBench-2024) measure social bias and stereotypes across several dimensions, including religion.
findings: Retrieval-enabled AI agents consistently show a degradation in safety, which includes exhibiting stronger stereotypical responses related to social biases. Since religion is one of the bias categories evaluated, the findings indicate that enabling information retrieval increases the propagation of religious biases in model outputs, even for models with strong initial safety alignment.
